description.raw: Scope: Hide Account Contact Relationship Currency (Account Contact) Delete Relationship_Strength__c (Account Contact) Remove picklist value “Other” from Roles and add help text (Account Contact ) User Story As a Product Owner / Data Owner I want the Account Contact Relationship field  Account Contact Relationship Currency  hidden, the Account Contact Relationship field  Relationship_Strength__c  removed, and the Roles picklist value  Other  removed (with help text added to guide users how to request a new role) So that the UI is cleaner, obsolete fields are removed, and users have clear guidance when the available Roles do not apply Description / Scope Account Contact Relationship:  Hide  Account Contact Relationship Currency  from standard users (remove from page layouts and set FLS so non-admins can’t see it). Keep the field in the schema for admins/support if needed. Account Contact Relationship:  Delete  Relationship_Strength__c  from the  Account Contact  object. Ensure automations, metadata and integrations are updated to remove references. (No existing data to migrate.) Roles:  Remove the  Other  picklist value from Roles. Add concise help text on the Roles field explaining how to request a new role when none of the options fit. Acceptance Criteria (GIVEN / WHEN / THEN) Account Contact Relationship  — hide field GIVEN a non-admin user WHEN they open an Account Contact Relationship record THEN  Account Contact Relationship Currency  is not visible on the page, compact layout or list views Account Contact Relationship — delete field GIVEN the Account Contact Relationship object after deployment WHEN users and systems interact with Account Contact Relationship metadata THEN  Relationship_Strength__c  is no longer present on Account Contact Relationship and no automations or integrations reference it Roles — remove Other & add help text GIVEN the Roles picklist WHEN a user views or edits Roles THEN the value  Other  is not available and field help text explains how to request a new role (example help text: “If a suitable role is not listed, contact the CRM Administrator or submit a Role Request to the Service Desk.”)
